import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)

# Color palette for brands
brand_colors = {'Leica': '#E63946', 'Fuji': '#457B9D', 'Pentax': '#2A9D8F', 'Olympus': '#E9C46A'}

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1)
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                c=brand_colors[brand], s=150, label=brand, alpha=0.8, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Brand')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Price by Sensor Type bar chart
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)
sensor_prices = df.groupby('sensor_type')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors = plt.cm.viridis([0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8])
bars = ax2.barh(sensor_prices.index, sensor_prices.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Average Price (USD)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars, sensor_prices.values):
    ax2.text(val + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${val:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=10)

# 3. Weight vs Max ISO with body type
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 3)
body_markers = {'Compact': 'o', 'Mirrorless': 's', 'DSLR': '^'}
for body_type in df['body_type'].unique():
    body_data = df[df['body_type'] == body_type]
    ax3.scatter(body_data['weight_grams'], body_data['max_iso'], 
                marker=body_markers[body_type], s=150, 
                c=[brand_colors[b] for b in body_data['brand']],
                label=body_type, alpha=0.8, edgecolors='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Weight vs Max ISO by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Body Type')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Model Year Timeline with specs
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 4)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('model_year')
for i, (idx, row) in enumerate(df_sorted.iterrows()):
    ax4.scatter(row['model_year'], row['megapixels'], 
                c=brand_colors[row['brand']], s=row['price_usd']/15, 
                alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
    ax4.annotate(f"{row['brand']}\n{row['model_year']}", 
                 (row['model_year'], row['megapixels']),
                 textcoords="offset points", xytext=(0, 15),
                 ha='center', fontsize=8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Megapixels', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Megapixels Evolution Over Time\n(bubble size = price)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
